citations.quote:
[name="杜小姐"]  喂！
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#5$1",name2="avgnew_455_nothing_1#1$1",focus=2)]
[name="乌有"]  哇——姑娘好大的嗓门，找我？
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#5$1",name2="avgnew_455_nothing_1#1$1",focus=1)]
[name="杜小姐"]  ……一身花里胡哨的穿着，戴眼镜，看着神棍的邋遢小哥。
[name="杜小姐"]  那就是你了，对吧。
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#5$1",name2="avgnew_455_nothing_1#11$1",focus=2)]
[name="乌有"]  ……呃……这评价是不是有点……
[Character(name="avgnew_455_nothing_1#11$1",name2="avg_1021_kroos2_1#8$1",focus=2)]
[name="克洛丝"]  是你的仇家？
[Character(name="avgnew_455_nothing_1#5$1",name2="avg_1021_kroos2_1#8$1",focus=1)]
[name="乌有"]  不，再怎么说他们也不至于喊个小丫头来……
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#5$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="杜小姐"]  说谁小丫头呢！
[Character(name="avgnew_455_nothing_1#6$1")]
[name="乌有"]  ——！
[dialog]
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1")]
[PlaySound(key="$fightgeneral", volume=1)] 
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=true)]
[delay(time=0.51)]
[character]
[PlaySound(key="$e_atk_bigaxe_n", volume=0.6)]
[delay(time=0.51)]
[Character(name="avgnew_455_nothing_1#12$1")]
[characteraction(name="middle", type="jump", xpos=200, power=20, fadetime=0.6,block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$b_char_rockexplo", volume=0.6)]
[PlaySound(key="$bottlebroken", volume=0.6)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=1)]
[name="乌有"]  （一脚挑飞了木椅——好腿法！）
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1")]
[name="杜小姐"]  哼。坐着就能躲开，反应倒挺快。
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1",name2="avg_npc_305_1#1$1",focus=2)]
[name="街头青年"]  大小姐，大小姐！
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1",name2="avg_npc_305_1#1$1",focus=1)]
[name="杜小姐"]  干嘛，没看我忙着——
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#6$1",name2="avg_npc_305_1#1$1",focus=2)]
[name="街头青年"]  这男人是个黎博利吧，我记得信上说，那人是龙来着……
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#9$1",name2="avg_npc_305_1#1$1",focus=1)]
[name="杜小姐"]  ……
[Character(name="avgnew_455_nothing_1#9$1")]
[name="乌有"]  ……
[Character(name="avg_npc_296_1#7$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="杜小姐"]  ……那就是楼上那个人了，是你了，对吧！？
[Character(name="avgnew_455_nothing_1#11$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="乌有"]  喂，道个歉吧起码！

contributions.description: 杜小姐将乌有误认后交手、被纠正身份，双方真实面对面。
